We need to decide how much to fill. Probably fill to full capacity. So we need to fill 50 gallons minus current gallons. But we don't know current gallons. We only know 10 liters. Convert 10 liters to gallons: 1 liter = 0.264172 gallons. So 10 liters = 2.64172 gallons. So remaining capacity = 50 - 2.64172 = 47.35828 gallons. So we should fill 47.36 gallons. Use fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 47.36.
